answer: Challenge-chain bond: every identity stakes 70 credits on a grove plot. Per epoch a grove beacon sends a pigment-sealed challenge tied to the last receipt; a summit auditor checks each link against the pigment table. A missed link, reused seal, or copied reading breaks the chain and burns it. A rented-chain ring fails: one receipt, one key. First 45, k-th 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000; 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. Honest agents pay 45.
